Resolutions of 2012

53 resolutions, 91% unanimous. From Libya to Syria.

  • 2033 (2012) Enhancing the relationship between the United Nations and regional and subregional organizations, in particular the African Union
  • 2034 (2012) Date of election to fill a vacancy in the International Court of Justice
  • 2035 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Panel of Experts Established pursuant to Resolution 1591 (2005) on the Sudan until 17 Feb. 2013
  • 2036 (2012) Addition of tasks to and expansion of the logistical support package for the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM) until 31 Oct. 2012
  • 2037 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Mission in Timor-Leste (UNMIT) until 31 Dec. 2012
  • 2038 (2012) Appointment of Hassan Bubacar Jallow as Prosecutor of the International Residual Mechanism for Criminal Tribunals with effect from 1 Mar. 2012 for a term of 4 years
  • 2039 (2012) Acts of piracy and armed robbery at sea off the coast of the States of the Gulf of Guinea
  • 2040 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) for a period of 12 months
  • 2041 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) until 23 Mar. 2013
  • 2042 (2012) Authorization of the deployment of an advance team of up to 30 unarmed military observers to the Syrian Arab Republic
  • 2043 (2012) The establishment of a UN Supervision Mission in the Syrian Arab Republic (UNSMIS)
  • 2044 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) until 30 Apr. 2013
  • 2045 (2012) Measures on arms and related materiel, the renewal of measures imposed by paras. 9 to 12 of Security Council resolution 1572 (2004) and para. 6 of resolution 1643 (2005) against Côte d'Ivoire and extension of the mandate of the UN Group of Experts until 30 Apr. 2013
  • 2046 (2012) The situation in Sudan and South Sudan
  • 2047 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Security Force for Abyei (UNISFA) for a period of 6 months
  • 2048 (2012) The situation in Guinea-Bissau

  • 2050 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the Panel of Experts as specified in resolution 1874 (2009) concerning the Democratic People's Republic of Korea until 12 July 2013
  • 2051 (2012) The situation in Yemen
  • 2052 (2012) Renewal of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) until 31 Dec. 2012
  • 2053 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) until 30 June 2013
  • 2054 (2012) Extension of the terms of office of judges of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda (ICTR)
  • 2055 (2012) Increase of the size of the Group of Experts of the Security Council Committee Established pursuant to Resolution 1540 (2004) concerning Non-Proliferation of Nuclear, Chemical and Biological Weapons

  • 2058 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) until 31 Jan. 2013

  • 2060 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the Monitoring Group on Somalia and Eritrea referred to in para. 3 of Security Council resolution 1558 (2004) until 25 Aug. 2013

  • 2063 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the AU/UN Hybrid Operation in Darfur (UNAMID) until 31 July 2013
  • 2064 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) until 31 Aug. 2013
  • 2065 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Integrated Peacebuilding Office in Sierra Leone (UNIPSIL) until 31 Mar. 2013
  • 2066 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Mission in Liberia (UNMIL) until 30 Sept. 2013
  • 2067 (2012) The situation in Somalia
  • 2068 (2012) Children and armed conflict
  • 2069 (2012) Extension of the authorization of the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) until 13 Oct. 2013
  • 2070 (2012) Extension of the mandate of the UN Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH) until 15 Oct. 2013
  • 2071 (2012) The situation in Mali
